name: Forgotten Loa Idols
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
When we fled the isles that Zalazane and his ilk now inhabit, we left behind many precious idols that help us commune with spirits we worship: our loa. They are of grave importance to our tribe.

The followers of Zalazane show no reverence for our loa and have scattered these idols across the largest of the isles.

This is an action that will not go unnoticed if we are not able to collect these idols, and offending a loa is a grave matter.

Go, find as many loa idols as you can and return them to me.
narrative.objectives: Collect 8 Forgotten Loa Idols from the Echo Isles. Bring them to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
narrative.offerRewardText: You have done a great deed for our tribe today.Unlike some tribes, our kinship with our loa is one of reverence and respect, and we owe them much.I would not want the Darkspear to fall out of favor with them.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you found our loa idols, Enve? We must begin our rituals again soon.
